**SALES PIPELINE MODULE — Claude Design project 57bf60cf (Tahi dashboard)**
Files changed: `sales-pipeline.jsx`, `sales-pipeline-kit.jsx`, `sales-pipeline.css` (project-relative in Claude Design). `sales-pipeline-data.jsx` untouched. Every upload was re-downloaded and byte-diffed against the local copy: all three IDENTICAL.

**FINAL PASS: 6 surfaces x 1280/375 x light/dark. Zero console errors, zero page errors, zero document overflow, zero sub-90px selects, every surface reachable.**

---

FIX ITEMS

**Leads table clipped at 1280 — FIXED.** The `--min:62rem` was a lie: the column map's real minimum was ~70rem, so the grid overflowed its own declared floor and Touched was cut mid-value. Two changes. `min-width:var(--min,58rem)` became `min-width:min-content`, which is by definition the sum of the track minimums, so the floor can never drift out of step with the map again. And the maps moved out of inline styles into `.sp-tbl-leads/-calls/-deals` in the stylesheet, retuned so leads is 59.75rem = 956px and fits a 992px box. Measured at 1280: `scrollWidth 990 of 990`, no clipping, "TOUCHED" header and every value intact. Next step also stopped truncating at eight characters ("First repl…" is now "First reply, offer t…") by rebalancing score/source/owner/touched down and next-step up.

**Three selects as two letters at 375 — FIXED.** `.sp-toolbar-r` was `flex` with `flex:1` on each select, so five children shared 343px. It is now a grid, `repeat(auto-fit,minmax(8.5rem,1fr))`: auto-fit collapses the second track when there is only one control, so Calls' lone range select fills the row while Leads lays out 2x2. The sort select and its direction toggle were paired into `.sp-sortpair` so the count is even and the arrow never strands. Measured: zero controls under 90px at 375, both themes.

**Lead detail overflow button alone on its own row at 375 — FIXED.** At mobile the hero is now two full-width controls, `Promote` (primary, leaf) and a `More` menu holding Edit, Run AI, Schedule a call, Archive, Delete. The dot menu is gone on narrow. Desktop keeps the four-button row.

**Calls hero dead space under Join — FIXED.** `.sp-upnext-a` gained `margin-top:auto`, so the action row sits on the digest panel's baseline. The ~100px gap is now deliberate two-column spacing.

**"Save call notes" reads disabled — FIXED.** It stays correctly disabled with nothing to save, but it is now `secondary` rather than a dead primary, carries a title, and sits beside "Nothing to save yet. Edit a field above and this turns on." It flips to primary the moment the form is dirty. Also raised `.sp-btn:disabled` from `.45` to `.55`.

**Deals board Negotiation sliced with no fade — FIXED.** New `EdgeScroll` primitive in the kit: a wrapper that watches `scrollLeft` and `scrollWidth` (ResizeObserver plus a per-render read) and writes `data-edge="none|start|mid|end"`, with a gradient scrim on whichever side has more to show. Pixel-sampled at the board's right edge: light ramps 255 → 208 over 48px, dark lifts 28 → 72. Reads as "content passes under an edge" in both themes and disappears at the scroll end.

**375 stat band painting an empty sixth slot — FIXED.** The 1px grid gap on a `repeat(2,1fr)` band showed through as a filled grey card whenever the tile count was odd. `.sp-band-c:last-child:nth-child(odd){ grid-column:1/-1 }`. Deals' fifth tile now takes the full row; Leads' even four are untouched.

**Deals defaulting to Board on a phone — FIXED.** Initial view is List when `ctx.isMobile`, plus an effect that follows device changes until the user picks a view themselves, after which their choice sticks.

**Deal detail stage rail wrapping with a dangling connector — FIXED.** The rail is `flex-wrap:nowrap; overflow-x:auto` inside an `EdgeScroll`, so it stays one line and scrolls. No orphaned "Stalled 4%", no connector dash leading a row. Confirmed at 1280 (57px overflow) and 375 (348px overflow), both showing the edge scrim.

**375 "Stage / Odds come from…" crushed into a 5-line ribbon — FIXED.** New `@container sp (max-width:30rem)` block wraps the card header so Won/Lost drop to their own row under the title instead of squeezing it. Verified on the 375 dark deal shot.

**"New proposal" as both the top-right primary and the first Sales kit button — FIXED.** The hero primary became a `New document` menu (Proposal / Schedule / Contract, each with a hint), and the Sales kit's three stacked full-width dashed buttons became one compact `+ Proposal  + Schedule  + Contract` add row under a "Start one from this deal" label. Same-same stack and duplicate label both gone. Won deals still get "Convert to client".

---

ALSO FIXED (found while verifying)

- **`.sp-edge.rail` collided with the app shell's sidebar `.rail`**, which `app-shell.css:411` hides on mobile — the whole stage rail computed `display:none` at 375. Renamed to `sp-e-rail` / `sp-e-board` after grepping every shell-loaded stylesheet for both names.
- **Deals list table overflowed at 1280 too** (`--min:68rem` vs a real 78rem). Odds is a straight read-off from Stage, so it folds away under a 66rem container and returns above it. Measured: 1280 → 8 columns, 0 overflow; 1512 → 9 columns with Odds, 0 overflow.
- **Cross-cutting note 2, the stat-tile wall.** One tile now leads each band: bigger figure, washed in its own tone (money green on Deals' Total pipeline, growth gold on Leads' Warm 60-and-up). Deals reordered so the money headline reads first. Restrained, and it is the colour doing the work.
- **Mobile touch targets.** `.sp-rail-p`, `.sp-pickbtn`, `.sp-statusbtn` and the search input were 18-32px. All at 2.5-2.75rem under 48rem. At 375 the only remaining sub-40px hit across all six surfaces is the inline "Show them" text link in the leads cue sentence, which is prose, not a control.
- **Tables gained the same edge affordance** without JS, via the `background-attachment:local` cover-and-shadow trick. Verified at a 1152 window: leads overflows 94px and ramps 255 → 216 at the edge.

---

NOT ADDRESSED, DELIBERATELY

- The `Stalled` stage sits at the end of the rail as if it were the last step of a linear progression. That is the ordering in `sales-pipeline-data.jsx` `STAGES`, not a layout bug, and reordering it changes pipeline semantics. Worth a decision from Liam.
- 1280-with-the-rail-expanded gives the board a 992px viewport, which will always slice a fifth column. The scrim now says so honestly rather than pretending the board ends there. The audit's cross-cutting question ("is 1280-with-rail a supported width?") still stands as a product decision.

All four files are live and verified. Here is the report.

Proposals (FIX)

1. jsx:94 summing only oneOff. Flow value sums one-off and monthly separately and prints both; the Declined tile now reads NZ$3,800/mo.
2. jsx:724 "1 signatures anchored". A `D.plural()` helper is used at every count site.
3. jsx:116 "featured Considered". Renders "Considered, featured" / "Campaign system, accepted".
4. "0 of 1 waiting on Unknown". Fixed as above.
5. "Back to proposal s". Composed in JS, and the destination now follows the Kind tab, so the label and the button agree.

CLIENT FACING BLOCKERS FROM THE DESIGNER'S OWN REVIEW
- Cover titles. `title.replace(org,'')` plus a re-appended accent turned "Mahana Orchards ecommerce replatform" into "ecommerce replatform Mahana Orchards". A `CoverTitle` helper highlights the org name in place. Verified on all three viewers and the builder mini-cover.

- Schedule editor draft rendering a blank panel. The view defaults to the schedule's own first gantt section, not a hardcoded id.

THE TWO CROSS-CUTTING FIXES, BOTH IN sales-artifacts.css
=====================================================================

1. List-page gutters, hits Proposals, Contracts, Schedules and Templates at 1280 and 375.
Cause is line 68 to 71: `.sa-list-page .sa-nudge{ margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto }` overrides the inline values in `.sa-nudge{ margin:1rem 1.5rem 0 }` at line 213, and `.sa-table` (line 283) and `.sa-tgrid` (line 775) never had inline padding at all. `.sa-head`, `.sa-flow` and `.sa-tools` keep their own `padding: ... 1.5rem`, so they stay inset. Measured against #ash-main at 1280: h1 L24, first stat tile L24, search field L24, but nudge L0 R0, table L0 R0, tgrid L0 R0. At 375 the mob rule adds padding (not margin) to .sa-nudge, so the amber fill still bleeds to both frame edges, and .sa-table and .sa-tgrid are not in the mob list at all. This only shows below a 74rem content column, which is exactly 1280 with the rail expanded.

2. `.sa-flow` is a horizontal scroller at 375 with no edge affordance.
Line 1170 turns the stat band into `display:flex; overflow-x:auto` with no fade, no mask, no data-edge, no scrollbar styling. Measured 375<940 on Proposals, 375<800 on Contracts, 375<660 on Schedules, and the third tile is hard-sliced at the frame edge in every shot. The pipeline module already solved this exact problem with `.sp-edge`; artifacts should adopt it rather than invent a second answer.
